description: This file defines the 'Tax' controller class for the OpenCart admin extension, specifically handling the display and saving of tax total settings within the admin interface.

classes.name: Tax
classes.description: Controller class for managing the tax total settings page in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles rendering the tax settings page, prepares breadcrumb navigation, load language strings, sets page title, and loads view with data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the saving of tax total settings; performs permission check, updates settings, and returns a JSON response.
